description:
FILED s450t (Opus, agent T of round 8).  NOT A BUG -- an available
simplification whose blocking reason has just gone away.

lib/English.pm ties $OS_ERROR / $ERRNO / $EXTENDED_OS_ERROR because, as the
shim's own comment and docs/not-supported.md said, "$! is a call into C
errno, not a variable at all" and "$^E is the errno ACCESSOR, not a cell, so
\$^E would take a reference to a temporary box instead of aliasing".

Since #561 (s450t) both statements are false: |$!| and |$^E| are defvar'd
canonical boxes holding a p-magic-cell over p-errno-string, so
`*OS_ERROR = \$!` would be a live alias in both directions, exactly like the
other punctuation names the shim already aliases.

WHY NOT DONE IN s450t: a lib/ change makes the full perl-tests sweep
non-optional (CLAUDE.md's what-to-run table, ruled s377), and s450t's own
bar was the runtime.  The doc text was corrected in the same session; the
code was not.

BAR: the English rows of Pl/t/english-01.t byte-identical to perl before and
after, the sweep, and the files that `use English` in the companion suite.
Keep the tie for $& $` $' $+ $^N $ARG -- those reasons still stand.
subject: lib/English.pm may drop the $!/$^E TIES for plain scalar-slot aliases now that #561 gives them canonical magic boxes
